items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Dave Brubeck’s first album on Fantasy Records

ctx.x: At the age of twelve I believe you broke your piggy bank so you could buy three records. And do you remember what those three records were?
Dave Brubeck’s first album on Fantasy Records, “Stan Getz with Strings,” and a J.J. Johnson album.
